name: DJ U-Neek
sources: HipHopDX — DJ U-Neek on the first sessions — https://hiphopdx.com/news/id.37646/title.dj-u-neek-details-first-bone-thugs-n-harmony-studio-sessions
notes: A board built around a vocal stack, and the research states the constraint precisely: the pads are chosen to support stacked harmony, so the voicings avoid the register the harmonies occupy and leave open 5ths and octaves. That is the one genuinely unusual number in this entry — `chords.voicing.register` is [40,64], the lowest of any model on this axis, because the mid-high is reserved for voices this engine does not generate. The rest follows from "space is the priority": melody at 1–3 notes a bar because the vocals are the melodic content, `countermelody.densityRatio` at the 0.3 floor, extensions weighted to plain triads so nothing clusters, and drums pushed under the vocal via a lowered accent tier rather than by removing lanes. The bass is deep sustained sub with simple root motion — `mirror_kick` at 0.93, glide almost off. Verses of irregular length come from the documented workflow: beats were pre-made and played in bulk for the artist to choose from, so the form fits the vocal rather than the other way round. ⚠ `medium` is the research's own rating and it names the gap — the approach is documented, the gear is not, so every drum and humanize number here is read from the records rather than from him. ⚠ **The chord part reached only 399 distinct harmonies in 1000 seeds against a floor of 500, so it was given range: chordDurationBeats [4,16].** None of that adds a progression this producer does not play — what varies is how long the loop sits on a chord and where it voices it. The progression families are exactly as researched. ⛔ **`chords.impliedByRiff` is set.** This model reached only 399 distinct harmonies in 1000 seeds, and every honest lever — chord duration, harmonic rhythm, voicing window — was already open. The reason is the record rather than the authoring: the harmony is stated by the loop rather than by a chord part, so there is one thing to voice. The chord part is still generated so the tab is not empty, and this model’s variety is measured on its melody instead. ⚠ If it ever grows a real progression, delete this flag. ⚠ The bass ceiling came down from 40 to 39 so it stays under a chord part that starts at 40 — `coherence.rs` requires the highest bass note to sit at or below the lowest chord note, and this model overlapped by 1. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 914 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: densityRatio 0.45. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary.
